title: Midnight Vegetables Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese dish featuring a variety of vegetables stir-fried in a savory sauce.

ingredients.name: vegetables (such as broccoli, carrots, bell peppers, and onions)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of Midnight oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to tenderize.
Add the Thai chili flakes, vegetarian oyster sauce, soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of Midnight oil and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until the sauce is well combined.
Season with salt to taste, and serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions, if desired.
